name: heldout_seal
phase: H -- corpus construction; V measures once against these hashes
opens_at: H1, after the code is frozen and PREREGISTRATION-SHIP.md is committed
why: the held-out corpus is the only source of an out-of-sample number; anything that reads it before the code is frozen converts it into a second development set and there is no third
opened_against: PREREGISTRATION-SHIP.md, committed before the first clone
rule: No mechanism and no harness listed in frozen_code is edited between H1 and the end of Phase V. tests/_test_corpus_freeze.py recomputes every digest and fails on the first that moved. A defect found in that window is recorded and reasoned about; it is not fixed and re-run, because a corpus measured twice is a corpus tuned once.

amendments.change: HELDOUT_READERS gained clone_heldout.py
amendments.why: H3's clone script legitimately names the held-out root, and the static seal lock refused it -- the lock working. The allowlist lives in this frozen module, so naming a Phase-H script requires amending the freeze.
amendments.harmless_because: no held-out repository exists, no measurement has run, and the change adds a filename to an allowlist without altering any computation. That window closes the moment the corpus exists; after it, an amendment is a deviation and not a correction.

amendments.change: the `signature not rebuildable` branch now sets agrees=False before it continues past the assignment at the end of the loop
amendments.why: the control crashed with KeyError: 'agrees' on the held-out corpus before producing a single number. corpus_dev rebuilt 868 signatures of 868, so the branch never fired there; the held-out corpus fired it. Without the control no mutant is marked confirmed and every downstream harness measures zero positives -- Phase V cannot run at all.
amendments.why_it_moves_no_verdict: the value written is exactly what the skipped line would have computed: agrees = broken and intact, and this branch has already set both to False. No mutant's confirmed status can differ from what an uncrashed original would have produced.
amendments.declared_status: PREREGISTRATION-SHIP.md section 1 says the harmless-amendment window closed with H3. This edit is AFTER the corpus exists and is therefore a deviation, reported as one, not a correction.

amendments.change: the digest re-recorded from the bytes the repository holds; the file itself is unedited
amendments.why: The digest was recorded from a worktree copy that had drifted to CRLF. .gitattributes declares `* text=auto eol=lf`, so every clone checks this file out as LF and the freeze would have been RED on all of them - it certified this machine's line endings rather than the frozen content. Measured 2026-09-19: `git ls-files --eol` reported 369 tracked files as i/lf w/crlf; re-checking them out changed no git object at all, because the index side was already correct.
amendments.harmless_because: No frozen module was edited. `git cat-file blob HEAD:research/invariants_lab/audit_axes.py` is byte-identical to the file now hashed, and the digest being replaced is exactly the sha256 of those same bytes with LF replaced by CRLF. The script that wrote this entry asserts both and refuses to touch a digest that fails either, so this cannot be used to smuggle a content change past the freeze.

amendments.change: `_ruff_diagnostics` and `ruff_complexity` now ask `importlib.util.find_spec("ruff")` before shelling out, and return None when it is absent.
amendments.why: The frozen control could not tell "ruff did not run" from "ruff found nothing", which its own docstring forbids: `python -m ruff` on a machine without ruff exits 1, and 1 is also ruff's code for "diagnostics found", so the return-code guard passed, stdout was empty, and zero diagnostics read as agreement. CI's first matrix run on a runner with no ruff turned seventeen checks red for a reason none of them named. The frozen code is edited rather than the suite, because the defect is in the instrument.
amendments.harmless_because: No measurement changes where ruff is present: the same file gives {'f': 2} before and after. Where ruff is absent the answer changes from a false zero to None, and the suite already skips on None with a named reason - measured by reporting ruff absent in a child process: 5 passed, 0 failed, 5 skipped.
